decision: Determine whether the pinned multilingual RNN-T can enter the existing Korean ASR full-accuracy and curated-speed evaluation without missing or truncated inputs.
decoding: Greedy native RNN-T; no manually imposed max_new_tokens, no chunking or per-sample fallback. Require full encoder exhaustion; record forced frame advances.

runtime.policy: New isolated image, source SHA and package inventory recorded per run; do not pool timing with the older Transformers cohort.
runtime.metadata_correction: The original resolved_parameters retained max_length=20 from static generation_config. Native RNNT computes a per-input buffer bound and uses encoder exhaustion. Later metadata code and derived reports describe that behavior; raw artifacts and actual decoding are unchanged.

pilot.purpose: Implementation, input/scorer validity and runtime feasibility; not a quality ranking.
pilot.gate: Both tracks complete with exact identities/order/counts, prompt 14, full frame consumption, no errors/OOM, inspected Korean predictions and diagnostic CER. Investigate forced frame advances and batch-dependent output differences before expansion.

expanded_evaluation.condition: Passing pilot and reconciled independent review; freeze configuration without selecting on observed CER.

strongest_confound: Different Transformers runtime and RNN-T decoding behavior from existing Whisper/Qwen rows. Report full provenance and a separate speed cohort; no claimed architectural cause of any quality or speed difference.
comparison_policy: Existing full-corpus Whisper large-v3/turbo and Qwen3-ASR rows remain fixed reference baselines. Pilot CER cannot replace full accuracy. Preserve all raw predictions including outliers and empty references.

authorization.scope: Nemotron integration and staged server evaluation; no training, other model sweep, API spend or public deployment.

pilot_validation.interpretation: Precision contributes to batch-dependent output, but does not explain all differences. Upstream native batch behavior remains a limitation. Empty outputs also occur with FP32 and are preserved. No claim of architecture superiority or streaming latency.
pilot_validation.decision: Keep predeclared BF16 / ko-KR / lookahead 3 and native B4 for full accuracy. No tuning or sample removal. Keep speed in its separate Transformers 5.13.0 cohort.

accepted: Hard-code prompt 14 and max_symbols_per_step 10 in benchmark launch checks.
Compare computed lengths with actual encoder attention mask: matched all 768 diagnostic outputs.
resolved_by_gpu_evidence: Top-level length method exists (also present in pinned Nemotron model source).
BatchFeature preserves int64 prompt [14]; durations include zero prefix and align with tokens.
max_new_tokens is None; all frames consumed.
Blank/pad filtering inspected in raw Korean predictions; no leaked special tokens.
remaining_limitations: B1/B4 native outputs differ on 33/192 BF16 and 8/192 FP32 cases; do not equate B1 quality with B4 full accuracy.
One input reaches the native 10-symbol frame guard in each BF16 pilot; all input frames are consumed and output retained.
